name: frostbound-reliquary
prompt: Create one finished combat background for Bound Souls, a dark-fantasy soul-creature RPG. This is an environment image ONLY, not a screenshot or concept sheet. Match the actual game's detailed 2D pixel-art aesthetic: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, rich layered shading, selective dark edges, subdued blue-green/teal and indigo shadows, weathered stone and organic forms, tiny restrained cyan/violet spirit-light accents. High-quality cohesive game art, atmospheric and mysterious rather than cheerful cartoon scenery. Do not use photorealism, 3D rendering, smooth airbrushed illustration, crude large blocks, or a pixel-grid overlay. Reference 1 is the game's environment tileset: use its bioluminescent teal/purple palette, vegetation and ancient stone language, NOT its atlas layout or black empty areas. Reference 2 is the approved Whisp character contact sheet: match its careful pixel detailing, earthy bone/wood tones and violet soul glow, but DO NOT draw this character, any other characters, the contact-sheet panels, checkerboards, pivot marks, labels or text. Reference 3 is the existing background for this biome: use ONLY its wide battle-stage perspective and generous clear ground, not its bright simple visual style. Composition is a single continuous wide landscape, 16:9, requested 1536 by 864 pixels. Slightly elevated, side-on JRPG battle camera, not overhead/isometric. Distant scenery and horizon sit in the upper third; continuous walkable ground fills the lower two thirds. Keep broad low-contrast standing areas around x=25% y=70% and x=75% y=61% with no raised platforms, circles or markings. These are for a closer left fighter and farther right fighter that the game adds later. The entire central battle area must remain unobstructed and lighter than the deepest edge shadows, with quiet midtones so dark silhouettes read. Frame detail at far sides and background. Top quarter and bottom fifth will partly sit under UI: no critical focal points there, no UI drawn. No people, creatures, ghosts with faces, skull characters, lettering, logos, borders, watermarks, weapons, or embedded interface. Opaque, edge-to-edge finished background. BIOME 3, FROZEN WOODLAND RUINS: Replace the cheerful snowfield with an ancient frost-covered clearing amid ruined soul-binding stones. Snow-laden dark blue conifers frame the sides, jagged distant mountain silhouettes and ruined low arches recede through violet-blue winter mist in the upper third. A few dim cyan crystal seams in half-buried broken monoliths sit only at the far edges and distant treeline, with restrained purple light hints. Broad smooth snow and frost-covered slate form the open battlefield across the lower two thirds, desaturated blue-grey/lavender midtones instead of bright white. Very subtle snow drifts and old stone fragments near edges; no central fissure, chasm, stairs or obstruction. Readable tranquil haunted winter atmosphere, no snowstorm hiding the fighters. Cohesive careful pixel clusters and earthy ancient stone language with the other two environments.
